usdRate.sourceName: European Central Bank euro reference rate (USD)
usdRate.note: USD 1.1172 per euro on 30 October 2026, i.e. EUR 0.8951 per USD; World Bank 2025 average 0.885.

inflation_cpi.note: CPI up 3.4% year on year in September 2026 (3.3% in August), published 13 October 2026; HICP 3.0%. World Bank 2025 average 3.2%.

inflation_projection.sourceName: ECB 2% inflation target; CBS CPI 2021-2025 average 4.6%, 3.2% in 2025 (StatLine 86141NED)
inflation_projection.note: The ECB target anchors euro prices, but Dutch inflation has run above the euro-area average for years (3.2-3.4% in 2025-26), so 2.5% is used for planning.

policy_rate.sourceName: European Central Bank deposit facility rate (series FM.D.U2.EUR.4F.KR.DFR.LEV)
policy_rate.note: The Netherlands uses the euro; ECB deposit facility rate 2.50% (read via the ECB data API).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Netherlands, household deposits redeemable at notice up to 3 months
savings_account_rate.note: Dutch savings accounts (spaarrekeningen) are reported as notice deposits; 1.26% in August 2026. Overnight (current-account) deposits paid 0.14%.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Netherlands, new household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year
fdr_3m_rate.note: No separate 3-month series is published; the up-to-1-year bucket (2.54% in August 2026) is used.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: ECB MFI interest rate statistics: Netherlands, new household deposits with agreed maturity up to 1 year
fdr_1y_rate.note: 2.54% in August 2026; 1-2 years 2.41%, over 2 years 2.82% (new business). Read via the ECB data API.

dps_rate.note: Dutch banks do not offer a fixed-rate monthly recurring deposit product with a published rate; regular saving goes into ordinary savings accounts.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: No weighted average across all household deposits was found (World Bank FR.INR.DPST stops in 2013). ECB MIR series for August 2026: overnight 0.14%, notice (savings) 1.26%, outstanding fixed-term household deposits 2.45%.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: The Dutch State Treasury Agency (DSTA) sells no retail savings certificate or savings bond to individuals; Dutch State Loans are bought through banks or brokers on the market.

tbill_91d_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Netherlands 3-month bill yield (bond table)
tbill_91d_rate.note: Secondary source: Dutch Treasury Certificates (DTC) are auctioned by the DSTA; 6-month 2.66% the same day.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No current 5-year Dutch State Loan yield was found on readable pages: Trading Economics lists 3-month, 6-month, 2-year and 10-year yields only, and worldgovernmentbonds.com loads data by script.

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: Trading Economics, Netherlands 10-year government bond yield
tbond_10y_rate.note: ECB long-term convergence yield for the Netherlands was 3.56% in September 2026 (IRS.M.NL.L.L40.CI.0000.EUR.N.Z); 2-year 3.08%.

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, Netherlands income determination (Box 3)
tax_bank_interest.note: No withholding tax on interest: savings are taxed in Box 3 at 36% on a deemed return (provisional 1.28% for bank balances in 2026) on assets above EUR 59,357 per person; taxpayers may instead declare their actual return if it is lower. Effective tax on actual interest is therefore usually well under 36%.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No retail government savings certificate exists; Dutch State Loans held by individuals fall in Box 3 (36% on a deemed return of 6% for other assets in 2026).

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: De Nederlandsche Bank, Dutch deposit guarantee scheme
deposit_insurance_limit.note: EUR 100,000 per person per bank; a joint account is covered up to EUR 200,000.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: Legal maximum annual rate on consumer credit is the statutory interest rate (4%) plus 8 points = 12% from 1 January 2026 (14% before). ECB MIR: revolving loans and card credit to households averaged 4.38% in August 2026.

equity_return_low.sourceName: AEX index 1,134 on 30 Oct 2026 (Trading Economics); 1-year deposit 2.54%
equity_return_low.note: Low case: a decade of weak European share returns, a little above safe deposits.

equity_return_base.sourceName: AEX index (Trading Economics); 1-year deposit 2.54% less Box 3 tax of about 0.46% = 2.1% after tax
equity_return_base.note: The AEX has risen from about 450 in 2016 to 1,134 (a strong record), but the base case is kept at the after-tax safe rate plus about 4 points, before the yearly Box 3 tax on investments.

equity_return_high.note: High case near the AEX's long-run total return of roughly 8-9% a year including dividends.

gold_return_low.sourceName: ECB euro reference rate against the US dollar
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price and a stronger euro.

gold_return_base.sourceName: ECB euro reference rate against the US dollar; long-run dollar gold trend
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% with no expected trend in the euro against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: ECB euro reference rate against the US dollar
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and a weaker euro.

fixed_income_return_low.sourceName: ECB MIR: Dutch household savings (notice) deposits 1.26%, less Box 3 tax
fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: easy-access savings after the Box 3 tax on the deemed savings return.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: ECB MIR: Dutch household deposits up to 1 year 2.54%, less Box 3 tax of about 0.46%
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case: rolling 1-year term deposits after the Box 3 charge (36% of the 1.28% deemed return).

fixed_income_return_high.sourceName: Netherlands 10-year government bond 3.42% (Trading Economics), less Box 3 tax
fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: locking in long Dutch State Loans after the Box 3 charge.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: Neither DNB, the AFM nor Kifid publishes an industry-wide life insurance claim settlement ratio that could be found.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life cover (overlijdensrisicoverzekering) is widely sold, but no regulator or official premium table per EUR 1,000 of cover by age was found; only company quotes exist.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: Everyone must hold basic health insurance, which covers hospital stays and operations; the patient pays at most the compulsory yearly deductible of EUR 385 (2026 and 2027), or up to EUR 885 with the highest voluntary deductible.

health_premium_table.note: Dutch basic health insurance is community-rated (one premium per policy regardless of age, about EUR 150-170 a month) and supplementary cover is priced per package, so no premium per EUR 100,000 of cover by age exists.

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: CBS CPI health (COICOP 06): +3.7% in 2025, +6.1% in 2024, +1.3% year on year in September 2026 (StatLine 86141NED)
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices rose 4-6% a year in 2023-2025 and health insurance premiums keep rising, so 3.5% (a point above the 2.5% projection) is used.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: CBS CPI education (COICOP 10): +3.4% year on year in September 2026, +8.8% in 2025 (StatLine 86141NED)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices swing with tuition-fee policy (cut in 2023, then raised), so 3.5% is used as a smoothed planning rate.

life_expectancy.sourceName: CBS StatLine 37360ned, life table 2025 (levensverwachting at birth)
life_expectancy.note: Men 80.67, women 83.46 in 2025; World Bank 2024 value 81.97.

life_table_remaining.note: Official period life table for 2025, both sexes and by sex (read via the CBS OData API).

support_ratio.sourceName: UN WPP 2024 medium variant via populationpyramid.net (old-age dependency ratio)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 33.3 (2026), 43.2 (2040) and 50.3 (2065, populationpyramid.net/netherlands/2065/). World Bank 2025: 32.5.

retirement_age_default.note: AOW age is 67 in 2026-2027 and 67 years 3 months in 2028-2031; it is then set each year, 5 years ahead, from CBS life expectancy (two-thirds of gains), so people born after 1975 (AOW from 2043 or later) should expect at least 67 years 3 months and probably more. Same for men and women.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: P-Direkt (central government HR service), end of employment at AOW age
retirement_age_government.note: Central government employment ends automatically at the AOW age (67 in 2026, rising with life expectancy); the page is from the 2020 information set, so older than 2025.

retirement_return_low.sourceName: ECB MIR: Dutch household savings deposits 1.26%, less Box 3 tax
retirement_return_low.note: Low case: mostly easy-access savings after tax.

retirement_return_base.sourceName: ECB MIR: Dutch household deposits up to 1 year 2.54%, less Box 3 tax of about 0.46%
retirement_return_base.note: Base case capped at the after-tax 1-year term deposit rate (about 2.1%).

retirement_return_high.sourceName: Netherlands 10-year government bond 3.42% (Trading Economics), less Box 3 tax
retirement_return_high.note: High case: a ladder of longer Dutch State Loans and deposits after tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: AEX index record; after-tax 1-year deposit about 2.1%
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: AEX index record; after-tax 1-year deposit about 2.1%
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half shares at 6% and half fixed income at about 2-2.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.sourceName: Sociale Verzekeringsbank (SVB), AOW amounts from 1 July 2026
old_age_allowance_monthly.note: Full AOW for a person living alone, EUR 1,662.16 gross a month (EUR 1,139.39 each for a couple), plus EUR 104.78 holiday pay a month paid in May. AOW is residence-based: 2% of the full amount accrues for each year lived in the Netherlands from age 17 (rising with the AOW age); a means-tested AIO supplement tops up an incomplete AOW.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Paid from the AOW age (67 in 2026, 67 years 3 months from 2028) to residents and former residents, with no means test; only the AIO top-up for incomplete AOW is means-tested.

gratuity_rule.note: No gratuity is paid on retirement: the statutory transition payment (transitievergoeding, one-third of a month's pay per year of service, Civil Code art. 7:673) applies only when the employer ends or does not renew the contract, and not when employment ends at AOW age (rijksoverheid.nl, ontslag).

public_pension_scheme.note: The AOW state pension is financed by payroll premiums but accrues by residence (2% a year over the 50 years before AOW age, starting at about 17); paid from 67 (67y3m from 2028), indexed twice a year with the net minimum wage, and taxed as income. Most employees also build an occupational pension in a sector or company fund.

dps.note: No fixed-rate recurring deposit product; regular saving goes into savings accounts.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: The State does not sell savings certificates or retail savings bonds to individuals.

tbill_91d.note: Auctioned by the Dutch State Treasury Agency, mainly to institutions.

equity_fund.note: Widely available; holdings are taxed in Box 3 on a deemed return of 6% (2026).

gold.note: No restriction on buying physical gold; investment gold is VAT-exempt.

insuranceRegulator.name: De Nederlandsche Bank (prudential) and Autoriteit Financiële Markten (conduct)
